component.name: Kami
component.summary: Tabbed notepad for plain text and Markdown

description.p: Kami (紙, Japanese for paper) is a scratch pad for notes, keys and drafts that never makes you save. Close it whenever you like and every tab comes back next time, unsaved ones included. It is a page, a few tabs and a menu bar: a text editor, not a word processor.

ul.li: Tabs that drag out into a window of their own and back again
Keeps every tab between runs, with the unsaved text in a folder only your account can read
Names an unsaved tab after its first line
A Markdown preview: headings, task lists, tables, quotes, links, images and colour-coded code blocks
Opens a file in its own encoding and line endings and saves it the same way, so Windows files keep their CRLFs
One Kami at a time: opening another file adds a tab to the open window
Notepad's menus and keys, Find and Replace, Go To, and F5 for the time and date
A translucent window with KWin's blur behind it

screenshot.caption: A trip note in English and Japanese, wrapped to a narrow window
